facts.text: The hotel is in the Chengdu Financial City zone in South Chengdu.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is situated on the modern Chengdu Financial City Zone in the heart of South Chengdu.

facts.text: The hotel is close to Jiaozi Park and the in99 shopping mall.
facts.excerpt: we are close to the tranquil Jiaozi Park and the fashionable shopping mall 'in99'

facts.text: The hotel is a ten-minute walk from Financial City North metro station on Line 1.
facts.excerpt: only a 10-minute walk from the Financial City North metro station on Line 1, the city’s main north-south spine

facts.text: Rooms look out over the skyline: city, park, or the Twin Towers of Financial City.
facts.excerpt: skyline—city, park, or the iconic Twin Towers of Financial City

facts.text: Each room has concierge cabinets, brass and walnut finishes, and a marble bathroom with a soaking tub and twin vanities.
facts.excerpt: Each features concierge cabinets, chic brass and walnut finishes, a fully stocked minibar, and a marble spa bathroom with a soaking tub and twin vanities.

facts.text: Bathrooms are stocked with Aesop products.
facts.excerpt: marble bathrooms stocked with Aesop products

facts.text: At night the Twin Towers put on a light show visible from the rooms.
facts.excerpt: At night, the towers have a light show that made me stop and stare out the window again and again before bed.

facts.text: Infinite Luck serves a traditional Sichuanese menu by chef Tony Yang.
facts.excerpt: Chef Tony Yang's traditional Sichuanese menu is sure to impress. Four contemporary private dining rooms are available.

facts.text: Infinite Luck is on the 50th floor.
facts.excerpt: Infinite Luck, a Michelin-selected Chinese restaurant on the 50th floor

facts.text: Infinite Luck was selected for the Michelin Guide in 2026.
facts.excerpt: The restaurant was selected for the Michelin Guide in 2026 thanks to a revamp of its culinary vision by executive chef Tony Yang

facts.text: Infinite Luck has four private dining rooms.
facts.excerpt: Four contemporary private dining rooms are available.

facts.text: Peacock Alley serves the Waldorf afternoon tea, which includes a signature Red Velvet Cake.
facts.excerpt: Peacock Alley provides an enchanting ambience to enjoy light bites to the Waldorf afternoon tea, which includes the signature Red Velvet Cake

facts.text: Afternoon tea at Peacock Alley comes with live piano.
facts.excerpt: Embrace the elegant afternoon tea time to the sound of live piano.

facts.text: Limited Edition Grill is an American grill styled by designer Jeffrey Beers, with a show kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Styled by renowned designer Jeffrey Beers, this American Grill restaurant offers a casual yet attentive dining experience in a relaxed setting with a show kitchen

facts.text: Brasserie 99 is a European-style bistro with Western and Sichuanese cuisine, including small hot pots and street foods.
facts.excerpt: Dine at a European style bistro with western and Sichuanese cuisine. More than 100 dishes are inspired by famous Sichuan traditional home style cuisines, such as small hot pots and street foods.

facts.text: The Limited Edition Sip bar has a craft cocktail menu and 52nd-floor city views.
facts.excerpt: The hotel bar, Limited Edition-Sip, is worth a visit for its craft cocktail menu, rich leather interiors, and 52nd-floor city views.

facts.text: The 48th floor has a heated indoor pool overlooking the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: The 48th floor also houses a 25-meter heated indoor pool overlooking the city skyline

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours for in-house guests, with sauna, steam, ice and salt rooms.
facts.excerpt: fitness center open 24 hours for in-house guests with sauna, steam, ice, and salt rooms

facts.text: The Waldorf Astoria Spa uses Valmont products for treatments.
facts.excerpt: Full Waldorf Astoria Spa with Valmont treatments

facts.text: A personal concierge plans custom excursions and fulfils special requests.
facts.excerpt: Your personal concierge will plan custom excursions and fulfill special requests.

facts.text: The hotel rises 52 stories above the Financial City district.
facts.excerpt: The Waldorf Astoria Chengdu rises 52 stories above the city's Financial City district

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: Pets not allowed

facts.text: The hotel offers connecting rooms.
facts.excerpt: Connecting Rooms

facts.text: The hotel has 1,234 square meters of event space.
facts.excerpt: With 1,234 square meters of flexible event space

facts.text: Eastern District Memory (Dongqu Jiyi), a former electronics factory turned arts and culture hub, is a concierge-recommended outing.
facts.excerpt: The former electronics factory complex was renovated into a creative arts and culture hub.

facts.excerpt: Infinite Luck is one of the city's finest Chinese restaurants
